verdict.rationale: Meilisearch ships an official MCP server that lets users create indexes, add documents, configure settings, and perform searches using natural-language prompts, confirmed both in docs and a live runtime probe showing a working stdio JSON-RPC handshake. This directly delivers natural-language operation via an AI agent interface layered on the core product. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on validation of the MCP natural-language workflow specifically (beyond vendor docs and one runtime probe), and broader evidence of NL support outside the MCP integration.
